title: P1-W1: TypeORM migration to VALIDATE CONSTRAINT the tenantId FKs from SS-002
description: Follow-up to SS-002. The original migration added tenantId columns + FKs to 25 tables with NOT VALID so it stayed fast on the orders hot table. New INSERTs/UPDATEs that violate the FK are rejected immediately; existing rows were not scanned. The data is consistent (all rows were backfilled to tenant_id=1 in SS-002), so validating now is safe. SS-002b is in flight (entity column sweep) and SS-002c is in flight (repo filter sweep) so any future orphan writes are also blocked. Files: libs/platform/typeorm/src/lib/migrations/1718160000002-ValidateTenantIdFKs.ts. For each of the 25 tables from SS-002, runs ALTER TABLE ... VALIDATE CONSTRAINT fk_<table>_tenant. The migration also defensively re-queries pg_constraint to skip tables where the constraint doesn't exist or is already validated (idempotent + resilient to drift). Skip the wallet tables (wallets, wallet_ledger) â€” those FKs are left NOT VALID permanently because the wallet data is append-only and self-consistent. VALIDATE CONSTRAINT takes a ShareUpdateExclusiveLock so reads + writes to the validated tables are not blocked. The migration's down() is a no-op (VALIDATE CONSTRAINT cannot be rolled back â€” the constraint was already enforcing for new rows, the validate just flipped a flag). Register the new migration in libs/platform/typeorm/src/lib/datasource.ts migrations array (appended after AddWalletTables1718160000001). DONE: migration 1718160000002-ValidateTenantIdFKs.ts created, validates 25 FKs (24 from SS-002 plus 1 from SS-002 itself for the tenant self-reference), registered in datasource.ts.

DELIVERABLES LANDED:
- OpenTelemetry: libs/observability/src/lib/otel/{otel.module,otel.bootstrap,trace.middleware}.ts. OTLP/HTTP export via BatchSpanProcessor to OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT (default http://localhost:4318/v1/traces), resource attrs service.name=swiftship-api, service.version, deployment.environment. Auto-instruments http, express, graphql, typeorm, ioredis, nestjs-core. No-op when OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT unset.
- Sentry: libs/observability/src/lib/sentry/{sentry.module,sentry.bootstrap,sentry.interceptor,sentry-exception.filter}.ts. Sentry.init before NestFactory.create; global SentryExceptionFilter catches 5xx only (4xx skipped); SentryInterceptor tags tenant.id / user.id / correlationId / breadcrumbs. No-op when SENTRY_DSN unset.
- Correlation IDs: libs/observability/src/lib/correlation/{context,correlation-id.middleware,correlation.module}.ts. Reads X-Request-Id / X-Correlation-Id, generates UUIDv4 if absent, echoes back on response, runs inside AsyncLocalStorage. withCorrelationId() helper for BullMQ workers and ad-hoc contexts. Nested runWithCorrelation() merges parent context so tenantId/userId survive.
- Audit log: libs/observability/src/lib/audit/{audit-log.entity,audit-log.service,audit-log.resolver,audit-log.module,audit-log.model,audit-log.input,audit-log.types,auditable.decorator,audit.interceptor}.ts. TypeORM entity on audit_logs (id, tenantId, actorUserId, actorType enum, action, resourceType, resourceId, beforeJson, afterJson, ipAddress, userAgent, correlationId, createdAt). AuditLogService.record() / query() / getForResource(). @Auditable() decorator + AuditInterceptor auto-records @Mutation resolver calls. record() swallows errors (console.warn fallback) so audit never breaks a request.
- StructuredLogger: libs/observability/src/lib/logger.service.ts. Upgraded with withCorrelationId() and withTraceContext() helpers, logAudit() convenience. Canonical JSON shape: ts, level, context, msg, pid + correlationId/traceId/spanId/tenantId/userId when present.
- GraphQL: AuditLogResolver @Query auditEvents + resourceHistory.
- Wired into apps/api/src/main.ts (Sentry first, then OTel, then NestFactory) and apps/api/src/app.module.ts (SentryModule + OpenTelemetryModule + CorrelationIdModule + AuditLogModule + ObservabilityModule). Other apps get a thin CorrelationIdMiddleware shim.
- Env vars: SENTRY_DSN, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT, OTEL_SERVICE_NAME. All no-op when unset.
- Migration: libs/observability/src/lib/audit/migrations/1718160000000-AddAuditLogTable.ts (idempotent).
- Docs: docs/observability.md (correlation flow, OTel/Sentry setup, audit retention policy).
- docker-compose.observability.yml: added otel-collector service (otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib:0.96.0) with receivers/otlp + exporters/logging exporters/otlp; receivers/otlp.endpoint=0.0.0.0:4317+4318.

VERIFICATION:
- npx nx test observability: 13/13 pass.
- npx nx typecheck observability: pass.
- npx nx run-many -t typecheck --all: pre-existing failures in onboarding/kyc/channels (missing path mappings + KYC strictPropertyInitialization) unrelated to this bead.
- api:typecheck / api:test / lint-all: pre-existing breakage (api jest.config.ts missing, eslint.config.cjs not parseable as ESM) not introduced by this bead.

- Per-tenant /health/<tenant-slug> controller (P6-W24 description mentions it but not in this bead's prompt).
- Status page / upptime config (separate deployment concern).

REQUEST FLOW: HTTP arrives -> CorrelationIdMiddleware extracts/generates X-Request-Id, runs `runWithCorrelation` -> OTel trace.middleware starts server span, sets traceId/spanId in ALS -> Nest resolves request -> resolvers/mutations run -> AuditInterceptor records mutation to audit_logs via AuditLogService.record() (swallows errors) -> StructuredLogger emits JSON line with correlationId/traceId/spanId/tenantId/userId from ALS -> response sent with X-Request-Id header echoed. BullMQ worker picks up job -> reads correlationId from job.data -> calls withCorrelationId(id, processor) -> log lines inside the worker carry the same correlation id, completing the trace from HTTP entry to async work.

Each service injects TenantContext from @swiftship/domains-tenants and has a private requireTenantId() guard. Wallet service also pre-existing findByTenant is preserved as the system path.
